Chunk Tasks

Chunk tasks using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

chunk_tasks(tasks, size=5)

Example input

{
  "tasks": [
    "Inspect",
    "Edit",
    "Test",
    "Review",
    "Package",
    "Publish"
  ],
  "size": 3
}

Example output

[
  [
    "Inspect",
    "Edit",
    "Test"
  ],
  [
    "Review",
    "Package",
    "Publish"
  ]
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py chunk_tasks < examples/chunk-tasks.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
